Akerlof's Lemons Market

Good cars vanish from a used-car market.

Only the seller knows the car's quality. The buyer sets the price by the average. At an average price, good-car owners refuse to sell. Only bad cars remain, so the price falls further. As the price unravels like this, trade itself disappears.

For example, there are 10 used 🚗 cars. A good one is worth 10 million won. A bad one is worth 1 million won. The buyer cannot tell them apart and offers the average, 5.5 million. Then every good-car owner walks away. Seeing only bad cars left, the buyer lowers the price again.
